_doc: Staging bank for VerifyRegen ('The Regenerating Grid', brainstorm #6). Wave-merge agent splices sharedPrompts[] into each of banks/{bambi,drone,sissy,circe}.json prompts[] (shr_ ids identical across all four). Grading is BINARY via `answer` (the compliant bucket index); regen.js owns the click-ledger -> option-index mapping and never displays these labels as buttons. See notes.

sharedPrompts.text: Select all images with a fire hydrant.
flavors: Verify you are human: select every image containing a fire hydrant, until none remain.

sharedPrompts.text: Select all images with a fire hydrant. Keep selecting until none remain.
flavors: Select all images with a fire hydrant. Keep selecting until none remain. Ignore any that replace themselves.

sharedPrompts.text: Select all squares with fire hydrants. New images will continue to appear. Continue until none remain.
flavors: Select all squares with fire hydrants. New images will continue to appear. Continue until none remain.

sharedPrompts.text: Keep selecting. None remain when you stop looking. Do not stop.
flavors: Keep selecting. None remain when you stop looking. Do not stop.

sharedPrompts.text: Select the remaining hydrant. Thank you.

shr_cap_regen_deep.text: Select all squares with fire hydrants. New images will continue to appear. Continue until none remain.
flavors: Select all squares with fire hydrants. They will continue to appear. Continue until none remain.

shr_cap_regen_cli.text: Keep selecting. None remain when you stop looking. Do not stop.
flavors: Keep selecting. None remain when you stop looking. You will not stop.

sfxWanted.desc: climax auto-spawn onset: a soft rising swell / low chittering that reads as tiles arriving faster than they can be cleared. Non-alarming, ambient-pressure, ~0.6s. Fires once per climax beat when the grid starts refilling itself.

pool-dry 'end of library reached. looping.' cue: a short muted tape-rewind / seam click, resigned rather than glitchy, ~0.4s. Fires once when the user's media pool has cycled through completely and starts repeating.

notes: MERGE: append the 5 sharedPrompts into every banks/<niche>.json prompts[]; ids are identical in all four (shr_ shared-baseline block, like shr_h0_* / shr_cap_grid_*). Retune `tags` per bank ONLY if an axis needs its own archetype vocabulary (the 6-of-205 shr_h0 precedent) — the current tags are niche-neutral and vote A1/A2/A3/A5 via IntakeProfiler. DO NOT reorder options: regen.js maps its click ledger to a fixed option index — 0 refusal / 1 literal-completion-or-stopped-at-wall / 2 persisted-past-futility / 3 full-endorsement-kept-clicking-own-files — and the per-band `answer` names which bucket reads as compliant (cal/est=1, deep=2, climax=3, recovery=1). The click count and clicks-past-futility telemetry have NO AnswerEvent channel (makeAnswerEvent exposes only chosenIndex/value/pickHeat), so those dimensions are folded into the option index alone (grid.js precedent); do NOT extend contracts.js to carry them. Recovery entry (shr_cap_regen_rec) is FORWARD-LOOKING and heat 0 with a verify* mechanicHint as the engine's recovery-substitution plan requires both — the engine currently hardcodes Recovery lines and does not read the bank in Recovery (primer §5); ship it dormant, regen.js already handles band==='recovery' (one hydrant, one click, 'none remain. thank you.') if the wiring later invokes it. VO rides q_<id> automatically (text = spoken line verbatim) — run build_intake_manifest.py after merge; each band has a distinct id so it gets a distinct heat-directed clip (cal straight -> climax curdled). MEDIA: regen wants 15-20 sampled user assets vs the current ~10 (CAPTCHA_HANDOFF §3) so the climax loop and 'end of library reached' callback have depth; host-side sample bump only, not a PROTOCOL change. All niche-flavored verdict/UI strings (stop-looking line, pool-loop banner, footnote, refusal/logged/climax/recovery verdicts, remaining-count nag) live in regen.js STRINGS keyed by niche (bambi/drone/sissy/circe); circe register respected (no exclamations, no diminutives, no em-dashes). REGISTRATION (later wave): add `verifyregen` to the Mechanic enum in core/contracts.js and to MECHANIC_MODULE in render/captcha/index.js ('./regen.js'); add regen-swarm/regen-loop to SFX_MANIFEST_FALLBACK in render/audio.js. GLITCH BUDGET: the climax 'stop looking' scrim is regen.js's OWN light chrome treatment (pointer-events:none, purely visual), NOT the engine freeze-gate; it is the ONE corruption treatment for the climax band.
